title: The Duck Pond
excerpt: A live duck pond: a small flock of mallards, every call synthesized as it happens and heard from where you stand on the bank.
content_html:
The Duck Pond

A small flock of mallards going about their day: three hens, two drakes and two broods of ducklings. No recordings. Every quack is synthesized as it happens and heard from where you stand on the bank.
